blocks.text: Meta 向 SEC 提交公告，计划通过增发新股募集 950 亿美元，用于资助 AI 数据中心及其超级智能推进计划。

inlines.text: Meta 向 SEC 提交公告，计划通过增发新股募集 950 亿美元，用于资助 AI 数据中心及其超级智能推进计划。

blocks.text: 首批 350 亿美元来自承销发行，包括 225 亿美元普通股和 125 亿美元强制可转换优先股，随后还将推出一项 600 亿美元的按市价发行计划。

inlines.text: 首批 350 亿美元来自承销发行，包括 225 亿美元普通股和 125 亿美元强制可转换优先股，随后还将推出一项 600 亿美元的按市价发行计划。

blocks.text: 英伟达、AMD 和博通——正是向 Meta 出售这批资金将购买的芯片的公司——表示有意认购最多 50 亿美元的股份。

inlines.text: 英伟达、AMD 和博通——正是向 Meta 出售这批资金将购买的芯片的公司——表示有意认购最多 50 亿美元的股份。

blocks.text: 此次募资之际，Meta 2026 年资本支出预测上调至 1350 亿至 1450 亿美元，而自由现金流转为负值，尽管前三季度经营性现金流达 970 亿美元，且拥有约 820 亿美元现金及证券。

inlines.text: 此次募资之际，Meta 2026 年资本支出预测上调至 1350 亿至 1450 亿美元，而自由现金流转为负值，尽管前三季度经营性现金流达 970 亿美元，且拥有约 820 亿美元现金及证券。

blocks.text: Meta 表示，这笔资金将支持 4 个各自超过 1 吉瓦的超级集群、其 Muse 智能体以及一项数据中心业务，此外还有债务和合作融资。

blocks.text: Meta filed the announcement with the SEC that it plans to raise $95B in new equity to fund AI data centers and its superintelligence push.

inlines.text: Meta filed the announcement with the SEC that it plans to raise $95B in new equity to fund AI data centers and its superintelligence push.

blocks.text: The first $35B comes from underwritten offerings of $22.5B in common stock and $12.5B in mandatory convertible preferred shares, with a $60B at-the-market program to follow.

inlines.text: The first $35B comes from underwritten offerings of $22.5B in common stock and $12.5B in mandatory convertible preferred shares, with a $60B at-the-market program to follow.

blocks.text: Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom, which sell Meta the chips this money will buy, indicated interest in taking up to $5B of the shares.

inlines.text: Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom, which sell Meta the chips this money will buy, indicated interest in taking up to $5B of the shares.

blocks.text: The raise comes as Meta’s 2026 capex forecast rose to $135B to $145B while free cash flow turned negative, despite $97B of operating cash flow in the first 3 quarters and about $82B in cash and securities.

blocks.text: Meta says the money supports 4 superclusters above 1 gigawatt each, its Muse agent and a data center business, alongside debt and partnership financing.
